text:
maria.chen: Heads up — PR #4223 changed the /v1/embeddings example but the published API ref still shows \u2018input_text\u2019 (single string). The new schema expects \u2018input\u2019 as an array. This is breaking the Go SDK example in the docs preview. Can someone update the sample payloads and the Go snippet? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4223

ryan: On it. I can update curl/python/go snippets + add a short migration note. Do we want to keep the old example as a "legacy" block?

sasha: Prefer a small migration section (two lines) showing old -> new. Keep one legacy example but mark it deprecated. Also need to update the OpenAPI examples so the SDK generator picks up the new shape. cc @docs-bot

docs-bot: docs-lint check failed on PR 4223: example mismatch in openapi/embeddings.yaml: 'input_text' not in schema (line 124). See CI details: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/4223/logs

maria.chen: Thanks — @ryan please take ownership. Make sure the change is in both the markdown and openapi examples so generated snippets update. Also please add a changelog note under docs/changes/ (one sentence).

ryan: Assigned to me. Pushing branch docs/embeddings-example-fix. Will add migration note and update OpenAPI. Draft of the new example I'm going to use:

```
# curl example
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rwd-embed-1",
  "input": ["this is a test", "another sentence"]
}
```

And the Go snippet change (simple payload):

```go
req := &EmbeddingsRequest{
    Model: "rwd-embed-1",
    Input: []string{"this is a test", "another sentence"},
}
resp, err := client.Embeddings(ctx, req)
```

sasha: That looks good. Quick note: add a single-line migration callout above the examples: "Previously: \u2018input_text\u2019 (string). Now: \u2018input\u2019 (array of strings)."

maria.chen: :thumbsup: please update the OpenAPI example too so SDK snippet CI is green, then request one more review.

ryan: OpenAPI example updated, CI green. Added migration callout and changelog entry. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4223/files. Ready for merge.

sasha: LGTM. Preview site shows new snippets. Merging after one more quick check.

maria.chen: Thanks all — merging now. Will follow up if any downstream SDK knock-on issues appear.
